title: Small trick to avoid CURSOR WITH HOLD queries when indexing
author: debnet
body_preview: Hello everyone,  I have a PostgreSQL database with millions of records that I need to reindex frequently. In my case, this was prohibitively slow because Django was using a server-side cursor in a way that led PostgreSQL to use `WITH HOLD`, which in turn generated a large amount of temporary I/O.
